items.source: Metadata indicating that instances of an annotated class are to be registered with a JMX server. Only valid when used on a Class.
items.translation: 指示已注解类的实例需注册到 JMX 服务器的元数据。仅在使用于 `<code>Class` 时有效。

items.source: Return the JMX ObjectName of this managed resource.
items.translation: 返回此托管资源的 JMX ObjectName。

items.source: Set the JMX ObjectName of this managed resource.
items.translation: 设置此托管资源的 JMX ObjectName。
